mechanisms: Ripemd160Ctx repr(C) layout and offset asserts
ripemd160_block_data_order over the shared md32 collector
two independent 80-step lines and the five-assignment combine
one-shot static-NULL arm and local-context cleanse
file_dispositions.note: crypto/ripemd/rmd_dgst.c, rmd_one.c, rmd_local.h and rmdconst.h. The collector's block contract (num * MD32_CBLOCK readable) is the only pointer obligation; the data pointer advances one block per loop iteration under num >= 1. The combine reproduces the authority's temporary reuse, and the one-shot cleanses its local context as rmd_one.c does. No change.

mechanisms: ShaCtx repr(C) layout and offset asserts
sha1_block ring-buffer Xupdate interleaved with the consuming round
ossl_sha1 direct-primitive one-shot and SHA1 provider one-shot
file_dispositions.note: crypto/sha/sha1dgst.c, sha1_one.c and sha_local.h. Expansion in place is safe because each ring slot is overwritten exactly before the round that reads it, which the code and comment pin. ossl_sha1 cleanly cleanses its MaybeUninit local after Final. ossl_sha1_ctrl refuses cmd != EVP_CTRL_SSL3_MASTER_SECRET, NULL sha1 and mslen != 48 before touching state; it cleanses sha1tmp after the outer update; padtmp holds only public pad bytes. SHA1 delegates to EVP_Q_digest and returns md or NULL exactly as sha1_one.c does. No change.

mechanisms: SHA3_absorb/SHA3_squeeze and the XOF state machine
file_dispositions.note: crypto/sha/sha3.c and crypto/sha/keccak1600.c (KECCAK_REF arm). Reachable invariants: update refuses FINAL/SQUEEZE and preserves bufsz < bsz; pad_and_absorb's buf[num] and buf[bsz-1] writes are in range; repeated squeeze drains buffered bytes before permuting. sha3_blocksize keeps the authority's (1600 - bitlen*2)/8 macro shape; callers supply the provider rows' constants or a legacy method's small md_size*8, so no hostile bitlen reaches the multiply. No change.

mechanisms: Sm3Ctx repr(C) layout and offset asserts
provider row as the only surface (no export)
file_dispositions.note: crypto/sm3/sm3.c and sm3_local.h. The loop form reproduces the authority's RND/EXPAND/P0/P1/FF/GG/T_j arithmetic and the XOR feed-forward; the collector establishes the staging bound and finalization layout. No #[no_mangle] surface is added, matching the authority's local entry points. No change.

mechanisms: WhirlpoolCtx repr(C) layout and offset asserts
file_dispositions.note: crypto/whrlpool/wp_block.c and wp_dgst.c. Update's 1 << 60 chunk keeps CHUNK*8, bytes*8 and blocks*64 inside usize; BitUpdate's counter carry, bitrem/inpgap arms, byteoff staging and 512-bit flush are the authority's. Final's byteoff is bounded by bitoff < WHIRLPOOL_BBLOCK, the padding arms stay inside data[64], a NULL md returns 0 without copying, and a successful Final cleanses the caller's context. No change.

mechanisms: shared DSA_AUX and its Sync justification
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dsa/dsa_asn1.c. Template offsets are offset_of!-derived and compile-time asserted at 4/8/16/24/104/112 with size 200, so a decode cannot target the wrong member. priv_key uses CBIGNUM_it, whose free path wipes the value. The callback returns 2 only when it acted and 0 on a failed DSA_new. All seven entry points match the authority's signatures. No change.

crypto/dsa/dsa_backend.c. The neither-half import succeeds; the private half is read only under include_private; the error path uses BN_clear_free for the private value and BN_free for the public. ossl_dsa_dup preserves the authority's domain-parameter-gated == 0 tests and releases a partial copy through DSA_free (which clears both halves). key_from_pkcs8 checks the negative-integer/sequence condition before dereferencing the parameter string, uses BN_secure_new + BN_FLG_CONSTTIME and BN_mod_exp, and follows the authority's BN_free/BN_clear-path release; the apparent plain BN_free of the private value is secret-safe because BN_FLG_SECURE routes this crate's BN_free through cleanse_storage. No change.

mechanisms: ossl_dsa_check_pairwise and its shared err path
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dsa/dsa_check.c. ret is an out-parameter written exactly as the authority writes it (priv_key zeroes before precheck; pub/partial rely on the FFC validator and then apply the && *ret == 0 ledger test). pairwise's BN_CTX/BIGNUM allocations are released on the single err path; allocation failure and mismatch both answer 0. The caller contract requires live dsa/ret pointers, which the provider keymgmt supplies. No direct unit test; callers compile and the suite exercises the crate. No change.

retained_observations: sha3_blocksize retains the authority macro's (1600 - bitlen*2)/8 expression. The only callers pass provider-row constants or a legacy method's small md_size*8, so no attacker-controlled bitlen reaches the multiply; changing the expression would deviate from the authority without closing a reachable path.

Whirlpool's BitUpdate accumulator invariants (bitoff < 512, inpgap <= 7, bits sufficient for a subtraction) are the authority's own and are maintained by the module's Init/Update/Final transitions. The C ABI contract remains the caller's readable-input obligation stated on the entry point.
